hooks.name: Re-typecheck apps when a shared package changes
hooks.description: When a file under packages/*/src is saved, the agent re-runs the repo typecheck so both apps and the template are checked against the change.

action.prompt: A shared package under packages/ changed. Both apps and templates/app depend on it. Run `pnpm typecheck` from the repo root and fix every error before moving on. Do not weaken types or add `any` to make it pass.
